name: Dr. Florian Jodl
headline: Consultant / Mentor / Coach to Founders and C-Level I Ex-Zalando (VP, pre-IPO) I Ex-McKinsey
summary:
Mentor | Consultant | Coach

With a background that spans McKinsey, Zalando, and academia, I bring a unique blend of hands-on experience and academic insight to my work. I was part of the leadership team that grew Zalando from a startup to one of Europe's leading e-commerce companies. Alongside this, I researched human motivation at LMU Munich and Columbia University. My Vipassana practice deepens my ability to see things as they truly are.

How I Work

I operate at the intersection of mentoring, consulting, and coaching — each offering distinct value. Mentoring can sometimes lack depth, consulting can be theoretical, and many coaches haven't experienced the complexities of the real world. My approach is different.

Mentoring: With over 15 years as an operator at Zalando, I led large teams and managed multi-billion euro P&Ls. I’ve lived through the challenges you're facing. I get it.

Consulting: Drawing on my years at McKinsey and my academic background, I’m committed to continuous learning and can provide actionable insights backed by rigorous research. 

Coaching: As a certified systemic coach, I don’t give you the answers. I help you find them within yourself by asking the right questions. Your growth is at the heart of my work.

If you're looking for a blend of real-world experience, academic rigor, and transformative coaching, let’s connect.
